_comment_stripCodexApps: models.<id>.stripCodexApps drops mcp__codex_apps__* namespaces (Gmail/GitHub/Drive). Default true on Muse (fatal), false elsewhere. E.g. deepseek with strip: { "deepseek-v4.1-flash": { "stripCodexApps": true } }
